build_waymo_open_dataset: build a tfds BeamBasedBuilder to load Waymo Open Dataset with camera images and object detection labels
create_waymo_open_dataset_config: create a WaymoOpenDatasetConfig builder config specifying name, version string, and GCS availability
run_generate_images_and_annotations: run _generate_images_and_annotations to yield images and annotations from a Waymo tfrecord file
build_bounding_box: build a tfds BBox from Waymo open_dataset box coordinates normalized to image dimensions
convert_labels: convert raw Waymo camera labels into a list of dicts with type and normalized bounding box
